components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one lime action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #a4c400; color: #000; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 14px 24px; font: 400 20px/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: lowercase; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; transition: background .2s cubic-bezier(.1,.9,.2,1), transform .12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b6d81a; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined rectangle; turns lime on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #fff; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 22px; font: 400 20px/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: lowercase; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; transition: color .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: #a4c400; border-color: #a4c400; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a4c400; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Colour Tile
components.description: A flat colour field with a title at bottom-start and a peek line.
components.html: foundersmvp interfaces and demos▸
components.css: .ds-tile { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; width: 320px; height: 160px; padding: 16px; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: lowercase; transform-style: preserve-3d; transition: transform .12s cubic-bezier(.1,.9,.2,1); } .ds-tile--magenta { background: #e3008c; } .ds-tile__title { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-tile__peek { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 14px; opacity: .85; } .ds-tile__glyph { position: absolute; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; font-size: 18px; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .2s; } .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile__glyph { opacity: 1; } .ds-tile:active { transform: perspective(600px) rotateX(4deg); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a4c400; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Outlined field; outline turns lime on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #000; color: #fff; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.62); border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 14px; font: 400 16px/1.4 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; width: 280px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,.62); } .ds-input:focus { outline: 0; border-color: #a4c400; }

components.name: Pivot Navigation
components.description: Horizontal lowercase links; current is ink, others muted, hover lime.
components.html: projectscase studiesdemosblogcontact
components.css: .ds-pivot { display: flex; gap: 28px; overflow-x: auto; white-space: nowrap; font: 300 20px/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: lowercase; } .ds-pivot a { color: rgba(255,255,255,.62); text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s; } .ds-pivot a[aria-current='page'] { color: #fff; } .ds-pivot a:hover, .ds-pivot a:focus-visible { color: #a4c400; outline: 0; }

components.name: App Bar Button
components.description: 40px square outline icon button for theme and language.
components.html: <button class="ds-appbar-btn" aria-label="switch theme"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M2 12h2M20 12h2M4.9 4.9l1.4 1.4M17.7 17.7l1.4 1.4M4.9 19.1l1.4-1.4M17.7 6.3l1.4-1.4"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-appbar-btn { width: 40px; height: 40px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; background: transparent; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #fff; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: color .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-appbar-btn:hover { color: #a4c400; border-color: #a4c400; } .ds-appbar-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a4c400; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio speaks the Metro typographic-tile language: a solid ground, giant light lowercase headlines cropped at the trailing edge, flat colour tiles as content, and one lime accent owning every live state. Nothing is decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Solid ground, white ink, flat saturated tiles
Giant light lowercase headlines cropped off the trailing edge
Varied tile grid as page structure
Metro-native motion: glide-in, press tilt, live flip

rules.name: The One Live Colour Rule
rules.body: Lime is the only colour that changes on hover, focus, or active state.

rules.name: The Tinted Secondary Rule
rules.body: Secondary text on a coloured tile is the tile's ink at 85% opacity, never gray.

rules.name: The Lowercase Rule
rules.body: Latin UI text is lowercase except proper nouns and product names.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: No shadows, no radii, no blur. A control's outline is its only edge.

dos: Do make headlines lowercase, light, and large enough to crop at the trailing edge on desktop.
Do build sections from varied tile sizes and let the grid be the structure.
Do use lime for every live state and nothing else for interaction.
Do mirror the crop edge, glyph, and alignment in RTL with Readex Pro.
donts: Don't use gradients, shadows, blur, glass, glow, or border-radius.
Don't use gold, cream, or serif type.
Don't hide navigation behind a hamburger.
